Street-level strip of small shops along Yanjiang Avenue in Yichang, Hubei, at night. A continuous twenty-four-metre frontage of one- to two-storey shopfronts: glass doors, warm interior light, red awnings and hanging red lanterns, roll-up shutters, air-conditioner units above, some potted plants, wet pavement with soft reflections along the bottom edge. Signs carry abstract, unreadable Chinese-like blocks only: no legible characters, no brand logos, no English. No people, no cars, no bicycles, no bridge. Straight-on eye-level elevation, orthographic, photographic, realistic ordinary Chinese riverside street, muted teal-and-amber night grade, warm practical lights.
